flow.name: 01 · Hello world
flow.notes: Smallest possible flow: any notification triggers an echo notification. Tests NotificationPosted trigger + PostNotification action + basic magic text. After importing: set packageName on the trigger to whichever app you want to react to (e.g. com.example.app), otherwise it will fire on every notification (incl. its own — debounce caps it at ~1/sec).
